name: Khadak Singh and Mob Charging (Hera Pheri)
visual_description: Kharak Singh (Om Puri) leading an angry mob of men wearing turbans and carrying wooden sticks, charging forward inside an industrial warehouse.
usage_context: Used to portray a squad, family, or group rushing aggressively or enthusiastically into a situation or confrontation.

example.top_text: Me and the boys rushing to claim free pizza at the office

text_areas.description: Situation causing the group to charge forward
